correctness.rationale: For every k≥1, generalized-binomial reflection plus Pascal identities reproduce exactly every alternating-prefix positional-count update; truncation of (1+X)^L in characteristic two makes all coordinates L-periodic. The word 01 translates the cyclic index by 1, giving reachability. The k-th output is a Lucas-theorem bit mask of period exactly L since shift L/2 flips the most significant one-bit of k in a state with output 1. Hence all L states are distinguishable by suffixes (01)^s and the machine is minimal. These steps were reconstructed for all parities including k=1 and powers of two; standalone literal and independent orbit/minimization programs verified 98,292 and 12,372 cases respectively; finite checks are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural memory requirement for streaming parity of an arbitrary alternating scattered pattern was not determined by the known fixed triple; the result gives a complete, all-length exact minimum and an unexpectedly tiny cyclic state realization, reducing an exponential 2^k prefix-counter representation to 2^{ceil(log2(k+1))} states. A sharp staircase at powers of two follows from the most-significant-bit obstruction. This addresses a motivated automata-minimization question rather than an arbitrary finite slice or restatement of standard counting recurrences.
